modmenu.descriptionTranslation.winterwon: A cozy, immersive winter ambience mod - turn your world into a snowy wonderland.
winterwonderland.config.title: Winter Wonderland Settings
winterwonderland.config.winter_world.too: Makes the overworld wintry, graded by biome: cold biomes get heavy snow, temperate biomes regular snow, warm biomes only light snow that doesn't stick. Affects newly generated chunks and weather.
How many snow layers pile up during snowfall.
winterwonderland.config.melt_on_clear_da: Deep snow slowly melts back to a single layer on sunny days.
winterwonderland.config.freeze_water.too: Lakes and rivers freeze over. Oceans only freeze along the shore.
winterwonderland.config.icicles.tooltip: Icicles slowly grow under roof edges and overhangs, and melt near light and heat.
winterwonderland.config.wintry_colors.to: Grass and leaves take on muted, frosty winter colors.
winterwonderland.config.wintry_color_str: How strong the wintry colors are.
winterwonderland.config.snowflakes.toolt: Snowflakes float through the air around you, even between snowfalls.
winterwonderland.config.snowflake_densit: How many drifting snowflakes are spawned.
winterwonderland.config.winter_fog.toolt: Soft misty fog during snowfall and a white-out in blizzards.
winterwonderland.config.fog_strength.too: How thick the winter fog gets.
winterwonderland.config.warm_glow.toolti: Gives torches, lanterns and fire a slightly warmer, cozier light.
winterwonderland.config.warm_glow_streng: How warm the block light gets. Keep it low when using shaders.
winterwonderland.config.frosty_breath.to: Players and creatures puff visible breath in the cold.
winterwonderland.config.wind_push.toolti: In blizzards, walking into the wind is a little slower and the wind at your back a little faster. Only outdoors.
winterwonderland.config.wind_push_streng: Maximum slowdown when walking into the blizzard wind.
winterwonderland.config.wind_sounds.tool: Soft wind during snowfall and howling wind with gusts in blizzards.
winterwonderland.config.snow_crunch.tool: Extra crunchy footsteps when walking on snow.
winterwonderland.config.fire_crackle.too: Cozy crackling near fires, campfires and lit furnaces.
winterwonderland.config.muffle_indoors.t: Wind and weather sounds get much quieter when you're inside.
